# How many cents a gallon do you actually keep after card fees, and is the store paying for itself?

> Free convenience store and gas station profit calculator: fuel margin after card fees, inside sales mix, labor and rent become monthly profit, break-even gallons, debt coverage and fuel margin sensitivity. Private, runs in your browser.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
